understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to guide the player through each level to the goal gem tile marked '+', while avoiding spike tiles and continuing until the game was won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was primarily horizontal using MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT. After moving horizontally, gravity automatically carried the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity was currently DOWN, meaning the player moved toward smaller y-values. CLICK removed clickable breakable blocks at a specified coordinate without moving the player, which could open new fall paths. Landing on spikes ended the attempt, and UNDO could revert the previous action. Each level allowed two attempts with a limited number of turns.
